text_block_list.text: While looking for Mejiro McQueen, who didn't show up for training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Megaphones ready! ...Off to the stadium we go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*... What is the meaning of this so suddenly?
I have somewhere I need to be, you see..."
choice_data_list: You haven't forgotten about training, have you?
You haven't forgotten about training, have you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... H-How could I let this happen!
I got so caught up thinking about the consecutive hit record...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-It's nothing at all!
My sincerest apologies...
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to be careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I will discipline myself once more.
And I shall certainly make up for this blunder!
